metadata.methodology: Exact coordinates and structured addresses are extracted directly from official Chick-fil-A location pages. Records are plotted only after canonical URL, Restaurant JSON-LD, U.S. state, unique directions coordinates, and geographic scope checks pass.
metadata.limitations: A published page verifies a public location record at the displayed coordinate, not current operating status, demand, capacity, routes, suppliers, distribution-center assignment, or service territory. Blocked or ambiguous pages remain unplotted.
